loadDefaultPack.name: Load Default Pack
loadDefaultPack.hint: If enabled, the default token pack (td00) will be loaded. Changes take effect after restart.

duplicateCheck.name: Duplicate Check Mode
duplicateCheck.hint: Choose how duplicate assets are detected. If disabled, all assets are included as-is. When set to 'By file size', files with the same size are considered duplicates and the one from the higher-priority pack will be kept. When set to 'By file hash', files with the same hash are considered duplicates and the one from the higher-priority pack will be kept.

dynamicTokenRing.name: Disable Dynamic Token Ring
dynamicTokenRing.hint: Disables the Dynamic Token Ring for tokens updated via the Token Manager. The Dynamic Token Ring prevents the token on the canvas from displaying animated assets.

tokenArtworkPreview.name: Token Artwork Preview Mode
tokenArtworkPreview.hint: Choose how token artwork should be previewed in the Token Manager interface. Requires reopening the UI to take effect.

tokenScale.name: Token Scale Increase
tokenScale.hint: Increases the current token scale by this amount when updated via the Token Manager. The original scale will be restored if you use the Rollback Token option.
